📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. A Elder veteran.

★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Tien was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
Tien showed Yuki the Ground Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
James showed Nora the Ground Elder — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

regDeaths.name: two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a toad like a war drum, throat swelling
the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up
